title: Fourier character of the paired torus map
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $m:(\{1,\ldots,n\}\times\{0,1\})\sqcup(\{1,\ldots,n\}\times\{0,1\})\to\mathbb Z$, and let $z=(x,y)\in\mathbb R^n\times\mathbb R^n$. The Fourier character of the paired torus image of $z$ is $\exp\!\left(i\sum_{j=1}^n\bigl[2\pi(m_{1,j,0}+\sqrt2\,m_{1,j,1})x_j+2\pi(m_{2,j,0}+\sqrt2\,m_{2,j,1})y_j\bigr]\right)$, where $m_{1,j,b}$ and $m_{2,j,b}$ are the values of $m$ on the first and second copies, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: Integer-valued frequency function on the disjoint union of two copies of $\{1,\ldots,n\}\times\{0,1\}$
Pair of real vectors $z\in\mathbb R^n\times\mathbb R^n$
